arxiv-2012-05056.creator: Jaider Blanco, Bernardo Uribe, Konrad Waldorf
arxiv-2012-05056.description: Abstract . We use Segal-Mitchison’s cohomology of topological groups to define a convenient model for topological gerbes. We introduce multiplicative gerbes over topological groups in this setup and we define its representations. For a specific choice of representation, we construct its category of endomorphisms and we show that it induces a new multiplicative gerbe over another topological group.

arxiv-2109-04021.title: Supervised Contrastive Learning for Detecting Anomalous Driving Behaviours from Multimodal Videos
arxiv-2109-04021.creator: Shehroz S. Khan 1,2 , Ziting Shen 2 , Haoying Sun 2 , Ax Patel 2 , Ali Abedi 1
arxiv-2109-04021.description: Abstract Distracted driving is one of the major reasons for vehicle accidents. Therefore, detecting distracted driving behaviours is of paramount importance to reduce the millions of deaths and injuries occurring worldwide. Distracted or anomalous driving behaviours are deviations from ’normal’ driving that need to be identified correctly to alert the driver.

arxiv-2208-10923.description: Abstract Despite the unprecedented downscaling of CMOS integrated circuits, memory-intensive machine learning and artificial intelligence applications are limited by data conversion between memory and processor. arxiv-2508-20927.title: Unsupervised Classification of Gamma-ray Bursts from Blazars (GRBBLs) with Machine Learning
arxiv-2508-20927.creator: Matteo Cerruti
arxiv-2508-20927.description: Abstract Blazars dominate the extragalactic γ \gamma -ray sky and show pronounced flares. Using public Fermi-LAT light curves for 732 blazars with secure redshifts, I implement an automated pipeline to identify and characterize γ \gamma -ray bursts from blazars (GRBBLs). Each event is modeled with an exponential rise/decay profile, and spectral variability is quantified via a constant fit.

arxiv-2509-13058.title: Finite coproducts, coregularity and coexactness for profinite interior algebras
arxiv-2509-13058.creator: Matteo De Berardinis
arxiv-2509-13058.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Matteo De Berardinis. In previous articles, we showed that the category of profinite L -algebras (where L is a normal modal logic with the finite model property) is monadic over Set . Then, we developed sequent calculi for extensions of the language of L with infinitary conjunctions and disjunctions, proving completeness with respect to profinite L -algebras and relating syntactic properties of the calculi with regularity/exactness properties of the category opposite to profinite L -algebras.

arxiv-2509-24030.title: From Edge to HPC: Investigating Cross-Facility Data Streaming Architectures DOI: XXXXXXX.XXXXXXX Conference: International Workshop on Innovating the Network for Data-Intensive Science in conjunction with SC25; November 16–21, 2025; St. Louis, MO, USA ISBN: 978-1-4503-XXXX-X/2018/06 CCS: Computer sy
arxiv-2509-24030.creator: Anjus George, Michael Brim, Christopher Zimmer, David Rogers, Sarp Oral, Zach Mayes
arxiv-2509-24030.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Anjus George, Michael Brim, Christopher Zimmer, David Rogers, Sarp Oral, Zach Mayes. In this paper, we investigate three cross-facility data streaming architectures, Direct Streaming (DTS), Proxied Streaming (PRS), and Managed Service Streaming (MSS). We examine their architectural variations in data flow paths and deployment feasibility, and detail their implementation using the Data Streaming to HPC (DS2HPC) architectural framework and the SciStream memory-to-memory streaming toolkit on the production-grade Advanced Computing Ecosystem (ACE) infrastructure at Oak Ridge Leadership Computing Facility (OLCF).

arxiv-2510-25624.title: Tidal dissipation and spin-orbit alignment due to the precessional instability in convection zones in rotating giant planets and stars 2025 Tidal dissipation and spin-orbit alignment due to the precessional instability in convection zones in rotating giant planets and stars – B
arxiv-2510-25624.creator: Nils B. de Vries, Adrian J. Barker, Rainer Hollerbach
arxiv-2510-25624.description: Abstract Tidal dissipation in star-planet systems occurs through various mechanisms, including the precessional instability. This is an instability of laminar flows (“Poincaré flows") forced by axial precession of a rotating, oblate, spin-orbit misaligned fluid planet or star, which excites inertial waves in convective regions if the dimensionless precession rate (“Poincaré number" Po \mathrm{Po} ) is sufficiently large.

uslaw-usc-t12-s5622.title: 12 U.S.C. § 5622 — Definitions
uslaw-usc-t12-s5622.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t12-s5622.description: United States Code, Title 12 (Banks And Banking); Chapter 53 (Wall Street Reform And Consumer Protection); Subchapter VII (Improving Access To Mainstream Financial Institutions). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. In this subchapter, the following definitions shall apply: (1) Account The term “account” means an agreement between an individual and an eligible entity under which the individual obtains from or through the entity.
